# Donga Kasi Pavan Kumar (Kasi)

> Kasi is a builder at heart — a software engineer who loves turning ideas into fast, reliable systems that just work, and keep working as they scale. He cares deeply about simplicity, clean code, and solving real-world problems with elegance. Beyond code, he enjoys writing and sharing thoughts that make people pause and think. He's not chasing trends — he's here to build things that last.
